summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for EVRYSDI (risdiplam, NDA 213535). The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion, and the Medical Review lists the Advisory Committee section as 'Not applicable.' Because no AC was held, there are no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
